text:
morgan: PR #8427 CI image push failing with registry 411 Length Required

morgan: build job log:
```bash
[buildx] Pushing layers...
http error: 411 Length Required
failed to upload blob: unexpected status 411
```

ada: ugh saw that earlier, did we change Dockerfile or build flags on that PR?

chris: no Dockerfile changes from me, but I flipped BUILDKIT=1 to speed up layer reuse in CI yesterday

vikram: possibly proxy issue — we pushed a squid upgrade to bastion last night that tightened header handling

morgan: oh that's the bastion proxy. CI goes through the bastion when pushing to registry in our subnet yes

infra-bot: deployment notice: bastion/proxy/squid v4.3.2 deployed 2025-01-12T04:12Z (change: strict header folding)

ada: that explains it. buildx/kaniko use chunked Transfer-Encoding for uploads, proxy rejecting without Content-Length

chris: workaround: set DOCKER_BUILDKIT=0 in CI job to avoid chunked uploads — can test quick

morgan: re-running with BUILDKIT disabled now

ci-bot: [PR #8427] rebuild triggered by morgan

(3m later)

ci-bot: [PR #8427] push stage still failing: 411 Length Required

vikram: hmm proxy rollback then. rolling back squid config to accept Transfer-Encoding: chunked

infra-bot: rollback performed: bastion/proxy v4.3.1 restored 2025-01-12T04:20Z

morgan: re-run again after rollback

ci-bot: [PR #8427] rebuild triggered by morgan

(1m later)

ci-bot: [PR #8427] build & push succeeded :tada:

ada: nice — follow-ups: 1) add a CI knob to disable buildkit for registry pushes until proxy hardening is coordinated 2) infra to add canary for proxy header changes

vikram: will add proxy canary and a changelog note. also will open infra ticket to harden acceptance tests for registry uploads

chris: adding short pipeline change to PR to set BUILDKIT=0 for now

morgan: thanks everyone. filing a postmortem/notes in the incident tracker and linking to PR

morgan: action items: infra ticket (#INF-331), CI tweak PR, and a <@vikram> follow-up on proxy rollout cadence
